mode.label: Suppression follows
mode.manualNote: Alert suppression follows each node's upstream as set by hand.
mode.shadowNote: A preview: alert suppression still follows the upstreams set by hand.
mode.derivedNote: Alert suppression follows the upstreams discovered from CDP/LLDP and shared subnets.
mode.revert: Go back to the hand-authored graph
mode.blocked: Cannot use the derived graph yet: {{pools}} has nodes but no poller placed in the graph. Set its poller's anchor node in <lnk/>.
mode.wouldSuppress_one: {{count}} active alert would newly be suppressed.
mode.wouldSuppress_other: {{count}} active alerts would newly be suppressed.
mode.wouldUnsuppress_one: {{count}} active alert would stop being suppressed.
mode.wouldUnsuppress_other: {{count}} active alerts would stop being suppressed.
mode.noChange: No active alert's suppression would change.
mode.coverage: {{covered}} of {{total}} nodes would get an upstream
mode.confirm: Upstreams found only by discovery will start suppressing alerts. That can hide a real outage, so check them under Compare first.

dependency.editHiddenInDerived: Upstreams are discovered in this mode. Correct a wrong link on the Network map.

only_manual.info: Switching to the derived graph drops this upstream, so this node's alert stops rolling up under it.

only_derived.info: Switching to the derived graph adds this upstream. This is the direction that can suppress a real outage, so check it first.

optOut.info: The derived graph never suppresses this node's alert. It only removes suppression, so it cannot hide an outage.
